content.text: {"label":"unknown_demand_surge","explanation":"Both queues are running well above forecast. Payments is +27.5% today and +50-64% in the last two intervals. General is +24% today and +42% at 14:00. The rise is spread evenly across every call reason, at roughly 1.2-1.5x normal on both queues, with no single reason dominating. That pattern rules out a specific product failure. The only open incident is a P4 staff-email delay with no customer impact, so there is no confirmed outage. The 07:30 KYC SMS does not fit either: account_update and login_issue are near or below their normal share. Attendance is normal, with 1 absence against about 2 usual on payments and none on general. AHT is broadly in line with forecast, so this is not system slowness. Service level is falling because volume exceeds staffing, and the information does not establish why demand is up.","plan_name":"Extend demand-side levers to end of day and add a small general overtime top-up","rationale":"The earlier mitigations expire at 14:00 or 16:00 while the surge is still growing, so the free and cheap levers should continue to 20:00. Callback on general ended at 14:00 and should restart now. Payments callback and chat deflection end at 16:00 and should be extended. Coaching cancellation should be extended past 16:00. General can also use chat deflection on balance_enquiry, its second-largest reason, which is running 1.24x normal. Both queues are below 70% service level, so cross-skilled moves are not allowed. Breaks from 14:15 to 16:00 are delayed 30 min to cover the current peak; agents already delayed at 11:30 are skipped automatically, and this only borrows capacity. Expected overtime spend is already about Rs 12,960 (8+6 payments agents and 4 general agents at 2 h each), leaving about Rs 2,000. The remaining budget goes on a modest general offer: about 2 accepted agents for 2 h, roughly Rs 1,440.
